cohort: Phase 01 eligibility and Phase 03 expanding folds for the named market
holdouts: 2526 and 2627 are reserved historical holdouts with known original-project aggregate results
limitations: Publication and odds timing proxies do not establish the scraped article version at prediction time
Primary sections can contain explicit predictions and scorelines
The same development folds select L2 and supply pooled OOF scores

text_preprocessing.whitespace: Collapse whitespace and join sections with single spaces; missing sections are empty

models.M1: Multinomial logistic regression with standardized log market probabilities
models.M2: Market residual with standardized log market probabilities
models.M5_full: M5 with full-article TF-IDF at the selected M5 L2

objective: Mean multinomial log loss + l2/2 * squared slope norm; intercepts unpenalized
residual: softmax(log(p_market) + intercept + standardized_numerical @ B + weighted_tfidf @ C)
scaling: Numerical columns centered and scaled by training-fold population SD (unit scale for constants); no column scaling of TF-IDF; penalties use orthonormal class contrasts for residual models
selection_rule: Minimum pooled per-match OOF log loss among candidates converged in every fold; ties favor stronger L2

metric_conventions.log_loss: Natural logarithm with a realized probability floor of 1e-15
metric_conventions.brier: Mean per-match sum of squared class errors
metric_conventions.accuracy: Argmax with ties resolved in H/D/A order
metric_conventions.paired_log_loss: Mean per-match model loss minus reference loss; negative favors the model
